title: Lessons on Impact of Tuberculosis Screening on Business Prospects at High Footfall Locations from Recent Exercises at Bedok
what_it_is: Lessons on Impact of Tuberculosis Screening on Business Prospects at High Footfall Locations from Recent Exercises at Bedok

sections.label: Communication and business support measures
sections.summary: Clear communication with residents is key, and eligible hawkers and tenants received rental and service and conservancy charge rebates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: A key success factor for such operations is clear communication with residents, notwithstanding that residents were largely very appreciative of the efforts to keep them safe.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This is because in the absence of authoritative information, rumours will spread.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hence, in this case, the public would need to know exactly what to expect from the screening, the details and locations of the clusters, and be assured that the risk of TB transmission through casual visits or sharing a meal was low.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Further, measures will need to be taken to minimise disruptions to businesses and the community.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hence, eligible hawkers and tenants also received rental, and service and conservancy charge rebates to mitigate the temporary impact on their businesses.

sections.label: Urgency versus three-year period
sections.summary: The exercise suggested urgency, but the identification of 13 cases with genetic similarities occurred over three years from January 2023 to February 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The impression that was created, in my view, suggested one of urgency and criticality, but the very act which triggered the exercise, the identification of 13 cases with genetic similarities, occurred over a period of three years from January 2023 to February 2026.

sections.label: Genetically linked TB cases explained
sections.summary: CDA said whole genome sequencing linked TB bacteria across 13 individuals over three years, none from Heartbeat@Bedok or Bedok Town.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: CDA has also explained that the 13 cases were over a period of three years, but recent developments in whole genome sequencing, whole genome sequencing capabilities, they were able to track that the TB bacteria was genetically linked across 13 individuals – although none of them were from the hawkers, merchants or people working in Heartbeat@Bedok or in the Bedok Town.

sections.label: Lessons for future public communications
sections.summary: CDA will improve public communications and incorporate lessons into standard operating procedures for its next approach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: CDA will see how to better improve the public communications to assure people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: These are lessons we have learned and we will make sure that those lessons would be incorporated in our standard operating procedures in our approach next time.
